$comment: GATING FOR EVERY G-A/G-B/G-C CLAIM. Rules the two referred gate-semantics items. Both defects are in the DENOMINATOR, not the threshold, and in both cases fixing the denominator invalidates the threshold's calibration -- so neither is a code change. Authorizes no threshold movement.

binding_for_this_document.describes_concepts: all fourteen, as a property of the gates

ITEM_1_G_B_CONFIRMED_IN_CODE_THE_QUANTIT.verified: compute_gate_b_fire_rate lines 913-915: observed_max = max(positive_scores); floor = observed_max * floor_fraction; fire_rate counts positives >= floor. THE FLOOR IS DERIVED FROM THE SAME SCORES BEING TESTED.
ITEM_1_G_B_CONFIRMED_IN_CODE_THE_QUANTIT.what_it_therefore_measures: SCALE-INVARIANT WITHIN-FAMILY DYNAMIC RANGE, not firing. Multiply every positive by any constant and the statistic is unchanged, which is definitionally not a measure of whether a feature activates.
ITEM_1_G_B_CONFIRMED_IN_CODE_THE_QUANTIT.degenerate_case_reproduced: All-zero positives: observed_max 0.0, floor 0.0, 0 >= 0 ten times, fire_rate 1.0. A DEAD FEATURE SCORES A PERFECT PASS. Their 182 of 660 -- 27.6 percent -- is the measured consequence.
ITEM_1_G_B_CONFIRMED_IN_CODE_THE_QUANTIT.VERDICT: THE QUANTITY G-B THRESHOLDS ON IS NOT THE INTENDED ONE. G-B was specified as fire rate at 0.20x observed max, and 'observed max' cannot coherently mean the max of the ten numbers under test.
ITEM_1_G_B_CONFIRMED_IN_CODE_THE_QUANTIT.AND_THE_PROJECT_ALREADY_HAS_THE_RIGHT_RE: The frozen dose grid expresses Amplify values IN UNITS OF THE FEATURE'S OWN CORPUS MAX. A non-circular per-feature reference scale is already established elsewhere in this protocol and the causal stage already uses it. G-B USING A WITHIN-CELL MAX IS INCONSISTENT WITH THE PROJECT'S OWN CONVENTION FOR THE SAME QUANTITY.
ITEM_1_G_B_CONFIRMED_IN_CODE_THE_QUANTIT.RATIFIED_IMMEDIATELY_the_degenerate_guar: Return 0.0 when observed_max <= 0. STRICTLY STRICTER -- it can only remove passes, never add one -- and it makes the empty-list early return consistent with the all-zero case. Authorized.
ITEM_1_G_B_CONFIRMED_IN_CODE_THE_QUANTIT.RETRACTION_REQUIRED: The 182 dead-feature G-B passes are ARTIFACTS and must be removed from every count. The reported 61.1 percent G-B pass rate is not a fact about this run. The live-cell rate of 22/442 = 5.0 percent is the reportable figure, and even it is measured on the defective denominator.

ITEM_2_G_C_SUBSUMPTION_CONFIRMED_MATHEMA.verified_in_code: line 966: negative_scores = [*unrelated_scores, *near_miss_scores] -- G-A pools both. G-C at line 1029 uses near_miss alone.
ITEM_2_G_C_SUBSUMPTION_CONFIRMED_MATHEMA.verified_by_measurement: AUROC against a pooled negative set of two EQUAL-SIZED subsets is IDENTICALLY the arithmetic mean of the two AUROCs -- 4000 random trials, zero mismatches beyond 1e-12. With 15 near_miss and 15 unrelated this holds exactly.
ITEM_2_G_C_SUBSUMPTION_CONFIRMED_MATHEMA.the_implication: sep >= 0.90 with unrelated_auroc <= 1 forces near_miss_auroc >= 0.80, which exceeds the 0.75 G-C threshold. G-C CANNOT REJECT ANYTHING G-A ACCEPTS, at these set sizes and these thresholds. Their 0-of-1080 observation is not a sample property; it is a theorem.
ITEM_2_G_C_SUBSUMPTION_CONFIRMED_MATHEMA.the_docstring_is_provably_false: Line 935's 'ONLY specificity test' framing, and the 'different denominators, different questions, both required' claim, are false at these set sizes. Correcting it and emitting a machine-readable subsumption note is RATIFIED. Continuing to COMPUTE G-C so the record stays complete is also right.
ITEM_2_G_C_SUBSUMPTION_CONFIRMED_MATHEMA.VERDICT_ON_THE_REFERRED_QUESTION: REVERTING G-A'S NEGATIVE SET TO UNRELATED ALONE IS CORRECT IN PRINCIPLE, and for a reason sharper than redundancy.
ITEM_2_G_C_SUBSUMPTION_CONFIRMED_MATHEMA.the_sharper_reason: The current arrangement does not merely make G-C redundant. IT MAKES G-A SOMETHING OTHER THAN WHAT IT IS REPORTED TO BE. A 0.90 bar against a negative set that is half near-misses is a combined background-and-specificity test reported as a background test, while G-C is reported as an independent specificity test and is implied. THE PIPELINE REPORTS TWO GATES AND HAS ONE, AND THE ONE IT HAS IS DESCRIBED AS NEITHER.

THE_UNIFYING_FINDING_AND_IT_IS_WHY_NEITH.statement: BOTH DEFECTS ARE IN THE DENOMINATOR, NOT THE THRESHOLD. AND IN BOTH CASES FIXING THE DENOMINATOR INVALIDATES THE THRESHOLD'S CALIBRATION.
THE_UNIFYING_FINDING_AND_IT_IS_WHY_NEITH.G_B: 0.20 of a within-family max and 0.20 of a corpus max are completely different bars. Re-pointing the reference while keeping 0.20 would be a REQUIREMENT KIND CHANGE of exactly the class just named -- the number stays, what it means moves, and every existing check still passes.
THE_UNIFYING_FINDING_AND_IT_IS_WHY_NEITH.G_A: 0.90 against pooled controls and 0.90 against unrelated alone are different bars, and the second is easier. Reverting the negative set while keeping 0.90 silently loosens G-A.
THE_UNIFYING_FINDING_AND_IT_IS_WHY_NEITH.CONSEQUENCE: NEITHER FIX MAY LAND AS A CODE CHANGE ALONE. Each requires its threshold RE-DERIVED against the corrected denominator, which is a protocol change with its own artifact, not an engineering task.
THE_UNIFYING_FINDING_AND_IT_IS_WHY_NEITH.what_I_am_NOT_doing: Moving any threshold. The frozen values stand until re-derived, and re-derivation is not mine to perform unilaterally.

THE_CLAIM_CORRECTION_THIS_FORCES.their_headline: One viable candidate out of 180, blocked at G-B on one paraphrase family -- not fourteen concepts failed.
THE_CLAIM_CORRECTION_THIS_FORCES.accepted_and_it_must_go_further: THE GATE THAT REJECTED THE ONLY VIABLE CANDIDATE IS THE ONE MEASURED TO BE ANTI-CORRELATED WITH THE SEARCH TARGET. Spearman(separation_auroc, fire_rate) = -0.5234; G-B passes 0.333 of the time where auroc >= 0.75 and 0.718 where auroc <= 0.55; the G-B pass set and the G-A-and-G-C pass set are DISJOINT at candidate level.
THE_CLAIM_CORRECTION_THIS_FORCES.THE_CORRECT_STATEMENT_OF_THIS_RUN: 413287 found one candidate clearing separation and specificity 6 of 6 in both locales, and it was rejected by a gate whose reference scale is circular. THAT IS NOT A NEGATIVE RESULT ABOUT THE FEATURE. It is a defect finding about the instrument.
THE_CLAIM_CORRECTION_THIS_FORCES.PROHIBITED: Reporting feature 25995 as having failed discovery, reporting the 61.1 percent G-B pass rate, counting any dead-feature cell as a pass, or describing G-A and G-C as two independent gates.

ON_THE_SELECTION_FIX_THEY_DID_NOT_REFER.their_reasoning: Scoring all 80,000 features against the frozen gates from a cached activation matrix touches no threshold, no prompt byte and not the conjunction, with feature 25995 as its falsifier.
ON_THE_SELECTION_FIX_THEY_DID_NOT_REFER.the_reasoning_is_correct_and_the_SEQUENC: IF G-B IS DEFECTIVE, SCORING 80,000 FEATURES THROUGH IT PRODUCES 80,000 DEFECTIVE RESULTS FASTER. The selection fix multiplies the throughput of a gate this ruling has just found unfit for its stated purpose.
ON_THE_SELECTION_FIX_THEY_DID_NOT_REFER.REQUIRED_ORDERING: The selection replacement may be BUILT and its falsifier demonstrated -- a selector that scores all 80,000 and fails to return 25995 is wrong, and that test is valid regardless of G-B. But its OUTPUT MAY NOT BE TREATED AS A DISCOVERY RESULT until the G-B denominator is corrected and its threshold re-derived.
ON_THE_SELECTION_FIX_THEY_DID_NOT_REFER.why_this_is_not_a_veto: Building it now is right and the falsifier is well chosen. What must not happen is a k-of-80000 headline computed through a circular reference scale, because that number would be produced faster, look far more thorough, and be wrong in the same direction as the 180-feature version.

hard_stops: Landing a corrected G-B denominator while retaining the 0.20 threshold unexamined.
Reverting G-A's negative set while retaining the 0.90 threshold unexamined.
Reporting the 61.1 percent G-B pass rate, or any count including dead-feature cells.
Describing G-A and G-C as two independent gates at these set sizes.
Reporting feature 25995 as a discovery failure rather than an instrument finding.
Treating any k-of-80000 output as a discovery result before the G-B denominator is corrected.
